support.channelDetail: Email: support@klarheit.com · WeChat Service: Klarheit_Optics (Daily 09:30–20:30 Asia/Shanghai; off-hours messages answered by 10:00 next day, backup escalation via support@klarheit.com).
support.shippingDetail: Mainland China only, settled in CNY. Standard provinces: free shipping, estimated 10–14 calendar days including optician review, custom lens edging, QC, and delivery. Xinjiang / Tibet / Qinghai: ¥25 shipping, 14–18 days.
support.returnDetail: Unopened frames may be returned within 7 days of delivery. Custom prescription lenses cannot be refunded for non-quality preference changes, while any lab error, shipping damage, or adaptation issue qualifies for free remake or verified refund.
support.preSalesHint: Questions before paying? Support: support@klarheit.com · WeChat: Klarheit_Optics (09:30–20:30)
privacy.rxUsageDetail: Your prescription parameters (SPH, CYL, AXIS, PD) and recipient details are used strictly for optician verification, optical lab fabrication, delivery, and after-sales support. Raw prescription values are never sent to analytics.
privacy.cameraDetail: AR Try-On processes video frames locally in your browser. Camera tracks stop immediately when you exit or switch tabs, and live video is never uploaded to Klarheit servers.
privacy.rightsDetail: To request a copy of your account, prescription, and order records or permanent account deletion, email privacy@klarheit.com from your registered email. Verification and fulfillment complete within 48 hours.
